searchText: Did anyone investigate why Kiln beacon explorer shows this - after the slot https://beaconchain.kiln.themerge.dev/block/29149 there are a lot of empty slots. The next non-empty slot according to the explorer is https://beaconchain.kiln.themerge.dev/block/29309 , however it points to the parent https://beaconchain.kiln.themerge.dev/block/b8596845ad036528e7a81da0c3fdd7c9b23beb9f89839ffbd203c508a6c6c4ef that explorer doesn't know. Same with the next non-empty slots https://beaconchain.kiln.themerge.dev/block/29325. We had a bunch of explorer issues around that time, it is possible that we switched something.. Could you query your node if hte respective block exists? following to the recent call, here are a couple of things that might be helpful in troubleshooting with Teku: some interesting subcommands: - `./teku debug-tools -h` Utilities for debugging issues Options: -h, --help Show this help message and exit. -V, --version Print version information and exit. Commands: db Debugging tools for inspecting the contents of the database pretty-print, pp Print SSZ objects as formatted JSON generate-autocomplete Generate a bash/zsh autocomplete file generate-swagger-docs Generate swagger-docs for rest APIs. get-validator-assignment Gets the committee assignment for a validator at a specific epoch. - `./teku debug-tools db -h` get-deposits List the ETH1 deposit information stored in the database get-finalized-state Get the finalized state, if available, as SSZ get-latest-finalized-state Get the latest finalized state, if available, as SSZ - `./teku transition -h` Manually run state transitions Options: -h, --help Show this help message and exit. -V, --version Print version information and exit. Commands: blocks Process blocks on the pre-state to get a post-state slots Process empty slots on the pre-state to get a post-state - rest api (run teku with `--rest-api-docs-enabled --rest-api-docs-enabled` and go to: http://127.0.0.1:5051/swagger-ui ) increase debug level at runtime: `PUT /teku/v1/admin/log_level` dump current proto array: `GET /teku/v1/debug/beacon/protoarray` run archive node and storing non canonical blocks: https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-archive-frequency https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-mode https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-non-canonical-blocks-enabled teku metrics dashboard: https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/13457

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content:
following to the recent call, here are a couple of things that might be helpful in troubleshooting with Teku:
some interesting subcommands:
- `./teku debug-tools -h`
Utilities for debugging issues

Options:
  -h, --help      Show this help message and exit.
  -V, --version   Print version information and exit.
Commands:
  db                        Debugging tools for inspecting the contents of the
                              database
  pretty-print, pp          Print SSZ objects as formatted JSON
  generate-autocomplete     Generate a bash/zsh autocomplete file
  generate-swagger-docs     Generate swagger-docs for rest APIs.
  get-validator-assignment  Gets the committee assignment for a validator at a
                              specific epoch.

- `./teku debug-tools db -h`

get-deposits                List the ETH1 deposit information stored in the
                                database
get-finalized-state         Get the finalized state, if available, as SSZ
get-latest-finalized-state  Get the latest finalized state, if available, as
                                SSZ

- `./teku transition -h`
Manually run state transitions

Options:
  -h, --help      Show this help message and exit.
  -V, --version   Print version information and exit.
Commands:
  blocks  Process blocks on the pre-state to get a post-state
  slots   Process empty slots on the pre-state to get a post-state

excerpts.author: tbenr
excerpts.content:
- rest api (run teku with `--rest-api-docs-enabled --rest-api-docs-enabled` and go to: http://127.0.0.1:5051/swagger-ui )
increase debug level at runtime:
`PUT /teku/v1/admin/log_level`

dump current proto array:
`GET /teku/v1/debug/beacon/protoarray`


 run archive node and storing non canonical blocks:
https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-archive-frequency
https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-mode
https://docs.teku.consensys.net/en/latest/Reference/CLI/CLI-Syntax/#data-storage-non-canonical-blocks-enabled

teku metrics dashboard:
https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/13457
